backFields.label: Check-in Instructions
backFields.value: Present this QR code to a volunteer at the HackUTA check-in desk to pick up your physical badge. Once your badge is assigned, this registration QR code is permanently retired and your physical badge becomes your event pass for meals, points, and the shop.
